artifact_observations.reasoning: Slight smudging or 'melting' of the fine ear hairs into the green background, lacking the crisp separation seen on the right ear. Likely minor generation artifact or compression.
The whiskers appear to fade into nothingness or merge slightly with the cheek fur rather than extending as distinct, sharp filaments. This is a common AI weakness in rendering fine linear details.

selected_experts.reason: To confirm the specific breed classification and rule out look-alike breeds (e.g., English Cocker Spaniel) based on head proportions and eye shape.
To verify the anatomical correctness of the visible head structure, eye symmetry, and ear placement, even if full body keypoints are missing.
To closely inspect the boundary between the fine ear hairs/whiskers and the background for signs of bleeding, fusion, or unnatural blurring.
To assess overall sharpness, noise levels, and detect any subtle global artifacts like over-smoothing or inconsistent lighting.
